cohort: 135 full-term nulliparous patients with singleton fetuses in cephalic presentation undergoing neuraxial analgesia.
finding: A degree of asynclitism greater than 70 mm was significantly associated with an increased rate of cesarean deliveries, and the AIDA algorithm, integrating four geometric parameters including asynclitism, demonstrated high accuracy in predicting labor outcome.
mod_finding: A degree of asynclitism greater than 70 mm was associated with an increased rate of cesarean deliveries, and the AIDA algorithm showed promise as a decision support tool for predicting labor outcome and potentially reducing unnecessary cesarean deliveries.
cross-section timing: During protracted second stage of labor (greater than three hours)
